title: May We Study Together
translation: Om. May he protect us both together. May he nourish us both together. May we work together with energy. May our study be brilliant. May we never hate each other. Om, peace, peace, peace.
translation_hi: ॐ। वह हम दोनों (गुरु और शिष्य) की साथ साथ रक्षा करे। हम दोनों का साथ साथ पोषण करे। हम साथ मिलकर पराक्रम करें। हमारा अध्ययन तेजस्वी हो। हम कभी एक दूसरे से द्वेष न करें। ॐ शांति, शांति, शांति।

words.meaning: may we not hate each other

science: This is the classic prayer before study, for teacher and student together. It describes what good research groups still aim for: shared effort, brilliant work, and no rivalry.
